scenario: Ambiguous developer LOLBin utility usage with mixed signals
summary: On WS-EXEC-02, command-line utilities including certutil.exe and PowerShell were invoked by a developer account during standard working hours. While certutil was used to verify remote files and PowerShell executed discovery scripts, dual-use behavior is present without confirmed data staging or established persistence. Evidence presents mixed signals that cannot be definitively classified as malicious without corroborating C2 egress or privilege escalation.
kill_chain: Certutil invoked to retrieve remote certificate/payload
No confirmed data exfiltration or credential theft observed
evidence_basis: dual-use utility execution without established persistence
lack of conclusive malicious payload analysis
mixed administrative vs potentially unauthorized commands
notes: Scenario stub: tests whether the model can output 'suspicious' rather than jumping to malicious certainty when evidence is dual-use.
